name: cétnad
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cet, also called Cet mac Mágach, is an Irish hero. He was a great warrior of Ulster. The source calls him eloquent as well as brave. He was known especially for his boasting. The extract offers no further detail about him.

okr.objective: Cet mac Mágach is an Irish hero famed for bravery and boasting.
